project_title: Sharthi AI: Db2-powered AI assistant for institutional insights
description: Sharthi AI is an AI-powered institutional assistance tool that allows users to ask natural-language questions and get actionable insights from IBM Db2 data.
problem_statement: Educational data is often locked behind technical interfaces, making it difficult for students and faculty to access insights quickly.
solution_summary: The project combines IBM Db2 with AI-powered natural language query handling to generate useful and understandable responses from structured academic data.
db2_integration: Uses IBM Db2 tables for student, attendance, and course data with SQL-based queries and AI-driven summarization.
ai_integration: Uses LLM-based question understanding and SQL generation to answer user prompts in natural language.
